notes: The 1985 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: dedications (Twin Peaks, Boeddeker Park, the Tea Garden gates, the Vietor memorial), the Tea Garden plaques and a clubhouse naming.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the $27.8 million Candlestick Park improvement agreement with the 49ers (Crosby-Thornton-Marshall; no page), the Kezar master plan contract, the Beach Chalet renovation study, the Upper Great Highway schematic plans, the Randall Museum Buckley Room.
